name: render
description: Generates render.yaml for the Tovu server with a persistent disk, health check and manually supplied secrets. Config generation only; follow the output notes to deploy.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Writes the settings file for running the Tovu server on Render. You follow its notes to finish the deploy.

credentialCards.title: Connect Render
credentialCards.label: Render API
credentialCards.intro: Save a Render API key for deploying this site from Tovu. Deploys from Tovu are being added; until then the assistant can only look up your Render services with it. Writing the deployment settings file needs no key.
credentialCards.keyHint: In Render, open Account Settings → API Keys → Create API Key. The key has the same access as your Render account, so use an account that can deploy the site's service.
